# Stdlib Essentials

Reach for the standard library before a framework. This section is the *working set*; **Standard Library** (part 98) is the map.

## Planned chapters

| Module | Job |
|--------|-----|
| `pathlib`, `os` | Files and environment |
| `json`, `csv` | Structured text |
| `datetime` / `zoneinfo` | Time |
| `argparse` | Command-line flags |
| `logging` | What happened, when |
| `re` | Patterns (use sparingly) |
| `collections`, `itertools` | Batteries for loops |
| `subprocess` | Run a command |

Official tours: [stdlib 1](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/stdlib.html) and [stdlib 2](https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/stdlib2.html).
